items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This regularly scheduled security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass. Adobe is not aware of any exploits in the wild for these issues.

items.title: StyleSmuggler: Magento and Adobe Commerce 0-day RCE
items.summary: Sansec discovered StyleSmuggler, a zero-day vulnerability enabling unauthenticated remote code execution (RCE) in Magento and Adobe Commerce, with active exploitation observed since September 4th. Adobe released an emergency hotfix for this critical flaw, rated CVSS 10.0, on September 7th.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: Adobe released an emergency security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source to resolve a critical vulnerability (CVE-2026-75650) that could result in arbitrary code execution. Adobe is aware of this CVE being actively exploited in the wild.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability (Customer Account Takeover)
items.summary: This critical incorrect authorization flaw (CVSS 9.1) in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source allows unauthenticated customer account takeover, providing access to victim accounts and private data. It was fixed as part of APSB26-92 and added to CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on September 24, 2026, due to evidence of active exploitation.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source resolves critical and important vulnerabilities, including arbitrary code execution, security feature bypass, and privilege escalation. It notably addresses CVE-2026-71362, an unauthenticated customer account takeover.

items.title: Unauthenticated file upload in Amasty Order Attributes for Magento
items.summary: An unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw in the Amasty Order Attributes extension allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in. This vulnerability opens the door to remote code execution on affected systems.
